messages:
Ravi Kapoor: quick sync — we need a compact GA decision for the routing feature. focus: SLA boundary, docs MVP, monitoring knobs, and commercial language. can we land a safe Day 1?
Aisha Khan: propose "partial SLA" for hosted Tier A only. p99 server-side for non-streaming requests; streaming SLO as p95 chunk latency. keep wording conservative.
Tom Becker: agree. must define measurement precisely: server-side post-response complete (includes finalization for streamed sessions). I'll drop the exact query into the doc.
Nina Lopes: Docs MVP: 1) Quickstart cURL + SDK snippet 2) SLA paragraph with measurement definition 3) 'What We Monitor' section + runbook excerpt 4) Known limitations & billing note. I'll own 1+2.
Ravi Kapoor: Monitoring: start with 0.75% full traces and 5% latency histograms. set p99 alert threshold at 400ms with 5m debounce. keep noise low.
Tom Becker: Canary plan: 24h/5% traffic, rollback if sustained p99 > 500ms for 10m. add automated rollback step in the deploy job.
Aisha Khan: Commercial copy (draft): "Partial latency commitment for Tier A hosted customers. Financial remedies and credits are defined per-contract; framework to be finalized with Finance." keeps legal flexibility.
commerce-bot: FYI: Finance requests 'credits subject to contract' phrasing; avoid numeric credits in public docs.
Nina Lopes: Runbook excerpt I'll include: escalation matrix, oncall contact, sample Kibana queries, and a short 'how we measure p99' note. small code example for metric: ```percentile_over_time(99, request_latency_ms{route="/v1/gen",status="200"}, "1h")```
Ravi Kapoor: Owners & timing: Nina (docs + SLA paragraph) by tomorrow 6pm PT; Tom (metrics + canary config) by EOD today; Aisha (commercial blurb + finance sync) by tomorrow noon.
Tom Becker: No engineering blockers. I'll wire the dashboard tile and the rollback hook today.
Aisha Khan: Legal/Finance sync scheduled at 11am. will post any redlines here.
Ravi Kapoor: decision call: proceed with narrow GA as described unless hard blocker shows up in 24h. we'll run the 24h canary and validate telemetry. owners confirm?
Nina Lopes: confirm. Docs draft will call out streaming vs non-streaming measurement differences.
Tom Becker: confirm. I'll add the example alert rule to the runbook.
Aisha Khan: confirm. will coordinate with sales on framing. :thumbsup:
